title: Fridge Ko Chhua… Aur Ye Garam! 😳 #shorts
title_en: Why Is the Outside of Your Fridge Hot? 🔥 #shorts
description:
Fridge andar barf jamata hai… phir bahar se garam kyun? 🤯
Asal raaz: fridge thand banata hi nahi — andar ki garmi utha kar bahar phenk deta hai.

A fridge doesn't make cold: a special gas soaks up the heat from your food, a motor squeezes it, and the side/back pipes release that heat outside.

فریج ٹھنڈ نہیں بناتا — اندر کی گرمی باہر پھینکتا ہے!

#howitworks #urdu #shorts #science #fridge #EZOXIFY
description_en:
Why is the outside of your fridge warm? A fridge doesn't make cold — a special gas soaks up the heat inside, the compressor squeezes it hot, and the pipes in the sides/back release your food's heat into the room.

#howitworks #shorts #science #fridge #EZOXIFY
topic: Fridge hot outside — why the sides/back of a fridge are warm (it moves heat out, it doesn't make cold)
